audience: Croatian businesses and freelancers who issue invoices and offers in Solo

useCases.title: Find the invoices that are not paid yet
useCases.text: List the latest invoices of the account. Check the payment status of each one and see which ones have no payment date.

useCases.title: Check the line items and VAT of an invoice
useCases.text: Open one invoice to read the buyer, the line items, the taxes, the totals and the PDF link. Use it to answer a question from a client.

useCases.title: Follow up on open offers
useCases.text: List the offers of the account and read the status of each one. Open an offer to see the buyer, the items and the total before you call the client.

useCases.title: Review the products and prices in the catalog
useCases.text: List the products and services with the code, unit, price, discount and tax rate. Use the list to check the prices before you write a new offer.
